name: Hector Ai - Amazon
description: Hector connects Claude directly to your Amazon Advertising account — Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, Amazon DSP, AMC, and Search Query Performance — through 95 tools across 15 categories. Ask in plain English and get real performance numbers: spend, revenue, ROAS, ACOS, campaigns, keywords, search terms, placements, portfolios, and regions. See combined organic + ad health with TACoS and inventory. Create Sponsored Products campaigns with a dry-run preview before anything reaches Amazon, update budgets, bids, placements, and bidding strategy, manage keywords and negatives, build AMC audiences including lookalikes, track SERP rank with Ranking 360, and group spend by your own custom labels. Every write runs a preview you confirm first, and every change is logged in a full audit trail. Built for Amazon agencies and brand teams managing multiple profiles from one conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hector Ai - Amazon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hector Ai - Amazon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hectorai.live/amazon. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hector Ai - Amazon MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hector Ai - Amazon lists 95 MCP tools, including agency_list_brands, analytics_account_health, analytics_ad_group_list, analytics_amc_audience_list, analytics_asin_list, analytics_budget_pacing, analytics_campaign_name_list, analytics_custom_label_overview, analytics_custom_label_widget_detail, analytics_day_list, analytics_dayparting_heatmap, and analytics_hourly_performance.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hector Ai - Amazon?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hector Ai - Amazon in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Hector Ai - Amazon MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hector Ai - Amazon requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hector Ai - Amazon is developed by Hector AI Global Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
